name: Ring of Prey
source:
Ring of Prey is an otome game where the player will assume the role of a jaded young woman trying to navigate a society that she should have never had a future in. In this short kinetic visual novel, players get to experience what it's like to meet the heroine as a third party, a man named Andersen Hollens - and maybe bite off a little more than he can chew.

[From [url=https://zasshusylla.itch.io/ropotome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Ring of Prey》是一款乙女游戏，玩家将扮演一位疲惫不堪的年轻女子，试图在一个她本不该拥有未来的社会中游刃有余。在这部简短的动态视觉小说中，玩家将体验到以第三方的身份遇见女主人公（一个名叫安德森·霍伦斯 (Andersen Hollens) 的男人）的感觉，并且可能会咬得有点过分。

[来自[url=https://zasshusylla.itch.io/ropotome]Itch.io[/url]]
